sources.note: Developer OneDumbFox shares gameplay footage of Insurgency (2014) running on PS Vita with 40-60 FPS in 16v16 offline bots.

findings: Credible WIP port of Insurgency (2014) tactical FPS with working bot AI, physics, weapon handling, and audio. Gameplay footage shows real Vita performance between 40-60 FPS. No public repository or standalone VPK release URL yet, so it is retained as verified for review without ledger promotion.
vita_hardware_result: Runs 40-60 FPS in 16v16 bot matches, solid 60 FPS in 12v12 / 8v8 on Vita hardware.
vita_evidence: Direct footage showing 16v16 bot matches on Vita with working weapons and audio
risk_disposition: No risk signals fired; legitimate WIP showcase.
